Shmeisani.narrative: For a luxury apartment in Shmeisani (~175 m²), the recommended launch price is 696 JD/m², within a defensible range of 526–865 JD/m² (confidence: H, 0.76; 80% interval 526–865). This is anchored on 12 comparable listing(s), each normalised to the subject with market-derived adjustments and calibrated from asking to transaction level; comps needing fewer/smaller adjustments carried more weight. To stay representative of the whole submarket, the comp value was reconciled toward the robust median of all same-type sales (~773 JD/m² asking) by statistical precision, so a dense pool anchors the price level while the comps supply the subject-specific adjustments. Cross-checks: income ceiling ≈ 774. Convergence supports the estimate; divergence is captured in the risks. Future signals (development score 0.48) justify holding the launch toward the top of the range and raising — never cutting — later. Key risk: Methods broadly agree.
